title: Spec 010 Phase 3: independent CVE rule update channel (blocks on ADR-008)
description:
Deferred scope from spec 010 (Nimble CVE pipeline). Phase 3 lets the validator prefer a signed manifest at ~/.cache/caro/cve-rules/ over the embedded bincode blob, so rule updates can ship without a full binary rebuild.

**Blocked on:** ADR-008 (caro update self-update surface) shipping. This piggy-backs on that delivery infrastructure — no point building a second manifest/signing path.

**Acceptance when unblocked:**
- Validator checks cache dir timestamp vs embedded build_date
- Newer-on-disk ruleset loads in place of embedded CVE_COMPILED
- Signed manifest verified before load (reuse ADR-008 signature scheme)
- Fallback to embedded on any verification failure

**Refs:**
- specs/010-nimble-cve-pipeline/spec.md §Phase 3
- ADR-008 (pending)
- PR #879 (phases 1+2)

title: Nimble CVE pipeline — Phase 2: Build-time embedding + validator merge
description:
Compile YAML rules into caro binary at build time; merge with static safety patterns.

Deliverables:
- src/dogma/mod.rs + src/dogma/compiler.rs (shared YAML->CompiledRuleset; also used by Dogma spec 006 later)
- src/safety/cve_patterns.rs (CVE_COMPILED static via include_bytes!)
- build.rs extension (glob data/cve_rules/*.yaml, compile to $OUT_DIR/cve_patterns.bin + cve_generated_tests.yaml, set CARO_CVE_RULE_COUNT env)
- Cargo.toml cve-rules feature flag (default-on), build-deps bincode/serde_yaml/aho-corasick
- src/safety/validator.rs modification (union static + CVE in COMPILED_PATTERNS)
- src/safety/mod.rs re-export
- .github/workflows/safety-validation.yml picks up cve_generated.yaml

Verification: cargo build --release --features cve-rules; cargo test --test cve_generated; caro --version shows 'CVE rules: N'.
